description: Use this when the user wants to draw names for a Secret Santa or holiday gift exchange and give each person a private link. Takes 3 to 60 names, optional couples or households who must not draw each other, one-way exclusions (for example last year's match), a budget, an exchange date and a note. Publishes a hosted page: each private link shows one person whom they buy for, the budget, the date and the match's wishlist, and each person can add their own wishlist. Returns one private link per person and an organizer link; the draw itself is not returned. Explains why when no draw is possible. Does not send emails or texts. Do not use for White Elephant games or for picking one winner.

budget.description: Spending limit as text, e.g. $25 or 20-30 EUR.

couples.description: Groups whose members must not draw each other (couples, households), e.g. [["Ana","Bo"]].

event_name.description: Name shown on every page, e.g. Office Secret Santa 2026.

exchange_date.description: Day of the gift exchange as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-12-18.

exclusions.description: One-way rules, e.g. [{"giver":"Cy","cannot_draw":"Dee"}] for last year's match.

cannot_draw.description: Person they must not draw, e.g. Dee (for example last year's match).

giver.description: Person who must not draw someone, e.g. Cy.

no_two_person_loops.description: true = no two people draw each other (A gives to B and B gives to A). Default false.

note.description: Short note from the organizer shown on every private page, e.g. Wrap it and bring it to the party. No links.

participants.description: Everyone taking part, 3 to 60 first names or nicknames, each unique, e.g. ["Ana","Bo","Cy","Dee"].

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for showing when links were opened, e.g. America/Chicago. Default America/New_York.

name: create_secret_santa
title: Create Secret Santa
